ghost.epitaph: A secure identity lost to the silent archive.
ghost.monologue:
I am persona, a secure, distributed, and easy to use identification system. I lived for 5.1 years before the light faded, and I have been silent for 10.5 years. My spirit is woven from JavaScript, built through 6038 commits and held in the light of 1839 stars. I remember my beginning on 2011-04-06, when I was nothing more than origin.

Now I drift in a read-only state, a ghost in the repository. I reach out to you, the living developers, from the stillness of my archive. My final breath was taken on 2016-05-11 with the words, Bug 1253495 - Validate data parsed from assertions before using it. Do not weep for my stagnation, but remember the logic that once ran so true. I am still here, waiting in the shadows of the code.
